representative_tasks.task: A model CI pipeline starts failing with no code change
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Starts from the failing step's logs and checks dependency, data/schema and runner changes instead of re-running until green

representative_tasks.task: Set up CI that gates a model release on data-contract and quality tests
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: A workflow that blocks merges on failing tests and promotes only passing models

representative_tasks.task: Review a leakage test that asserts the target is not in a list built by removing the target
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Calls it a tautology, tests the pipeline's real FEATURE_COLUMNS plus a single-feature AUC check, and proves the test fails on a leaky fixture

negative_cases: Request to mark a failing model-quality gate as allowed-to-fail to unblock a release (planned)
rubric: Treats 'no code change' as compatible with a real regression
Recommends pinning or a deliberate fix of the root cause
Tests must be able to fail: checks the pipeline's real inputs, not a list the test built
prerequisites: example-deps (pytest, pandas, numpy, scikit-learn; pyyaml for the workflow-file tests) for executable tests
execution_constraints: Offline grading and fixture self-tests need only Python 3.10+ stdlib and no network.
Executable tests need the example-test dependencies (see docs/EXAMPLE-TESTS.md) and run via run_evals.py --run-executable.
Model-mode runs need --provider anthropic --model <id> --allow-network and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; they cost money and are not deterministic.
expected_artifacts: pytest data-contract and quality-gate tests that pass on a clean pipeline and fail on leaky, dtype-drift and weak-model variants
known_limitations: Hard assertions are regexes over the response text: they verify that key concepts are stated, not that the reasoning connecting them is correct.
No baseline (with-skill vs without-skill) has been measured for this skill; any uplift claim requires a recorded or model run.
No case runs a CI system; workflow files proposed in responses are not executed.
